> Starbie is an interactive desktop companion built following a written hackclub guide on halflife. It is built using XIAO ESP32 as the microcontroller(the brain of the system). This project is not a complete replication of the guide as it includes some extra features including custom underglowing effects, light, alarm system and interactive features.
